caption:
A trail, a sunset and, if you want it, a night in nature.

The walk to the Mirante das Cores goes with a local guide, at an easy pace, to a viewpoint over the mainland hills and the clay canyons. We shape it around you, from an afternoon walk to a night under the stars.

No rush. Just island time.

Tell us what you have in mind and we'll design it with you. WhatsApp +55 75 99715-4100 · link in bio

#MorroDeSaoPaulo #IlhaDeTinhare #Hiking #Bahia

campos.label: What to do
campos.title: A trail, a sunset and *a night in nature*
campos.subtitle: Mirante das Cores, made to measure
campos.alt: Two hikers with backpacks walking up a red clay road

campos.label: The start
campos.title: It starts *on foot*
campos.body: A walk with a local guide, at an easy pace. Bring a light backpack and leave the hurry behind.
campos.alt: Two hikers with backpacks walking down a village street

campos.label: On the way
campos.title: Sandy paths and *dark-water* streams
campos.body: The trail follows white sand and small streams with tea-colored water.
campos.alt: A dark-water stream between white sand banks and palm trees

campos.label: The landscape
campos.title: Clay, sand and *open fields*
campos.body: The ground changes color as you walk: red clay, pale sand and open fields.
campos.alt: Two hikers on a sandy path across an open field

campos.label: The viewpoint
campos.title: Sunset over the *mainland hills*
campos.body: The Mirante das Cores looks out over the mainland hills and the clay canyons. The walk is made for the afternoon, so you arrive as the light falls.
campos.alt: Sunset rays breaking through clouds over a dark horizon

campos.label: After dark
campos.title: When the light goes, *the moon rises*
campos.body: Staying the night is one of the ways we shape this immersion. Some nights, the full moon is part of the plan.
campos.alt: A full moon surrounded by clouds in the night sky

campos.label: Camping
campos.title: A small *fire*, a guitar
campos.body: Camping at the Mirante das Cores is a made-to-measure immersion. We design it with you and tell you what is possible for your dates.
campos.alt: A man playing guitar on the sand beside a small campfire at night

campos.label: Quiet stops
campos.title: A quiet *lagoon* along the way
campos.body: Time to stop, listen and look around. The best part of a trail like this is not arriving fast.
campos.alt: A calm lagoon surrounded by trees

campos.label: Good to know
campos.title: Made *to measure*
campos.body: Mirante das Cores is not a fixed outing. We shape it around you, from an afternoon walk to a night in nature.

campos.title: Design it with people who *know the island*
campos.body: Tell us what you have in mind and we'll help you plan it with our local team.
